reviewed_official_evidence.source: IEEE Standards Interpretations for IEEE Std 1588-2008, December 2011
reviewed_official_evidence.reviewed_fact: correctionField is signed Integer64 and negative values are representable. The responses describe conflicting tooBig sentinels: 0x7fffffffffffffff versus all bits one.
reviewed_official_evidence.does_not_establish: The auditor conservatively excludes both INT64_MAX and -1 from measurement. This local scope policy does not resolve the official conflict or establish one unambiguous normative sentinel.

coverage.unreported_family_semantics: No finding was emitted from these families. Parsing may have rejected input earlier, or the input may omit that feature. Absence of a finding is not proof that the family passed.
always_outside_scope: IEEE 1588 certification and complete normative conformance
Hardware timestamp authenticity, transport interoperability and absolute clock accuracy
Capture completeness independently verified from external evidence
Announce qualification and the complete BMCA port-state algorithm
Single-step, IEEE 1588-2019 minor version, 802.1AS, P2P, unicast/alternate-master modes and unknown TLVs
Competition originality approval or acceptance of the submission

not_checked: Full IEEE compliance, clock accuracy, hardware/transport, qualification and port-state BMCA, unsupported profiles/TLVs, capture completeness
